I use a toothbrush.

It was supposed to be a fun day. "Bring Your Pet to Work Day," the memo said. "Foster team bonding!" It did not say, "Prepare for immediate termination and potential federal indictment."

Gary, my parrot, is a Green-Cheeked Conure with a vocabulary that ranges from "Pretty Bird" to "The Q3 projections are a lie." I thought he was just mimicking the TV. I was wrong. He was mimicking *me*.

The crisis began at 9:15 AM. I was in a meeting with the CEO, discussing the merger. Gary was perched on my shoulder, wearing a tiny tie I’d bought him for the occasion.

"So, as I was saying," the CEO droned, "the synergy between our two firms is..."

Gary tilted his head. "Synergy? More like synergy of the soul, Gary! And the wire transfers to the Cayman account are pending!"

The room went silent. The CEO’s pen stopped moving. My boss, Linda, slowly turned her head toward me.

I panicked. "He’s... he’s a very dramatic bird!" I squeaked. "He watches too much news!"

Gary hopped onto the conference table. "Linda! You’re wearing the blue blouse! It makes your eyes pop! Also, you’ve been embezzling from the petty cash for three years!"

Linda gasped. "That’s not true!"

Gary squawked, "It is true! I saw the receipts! And the CEO’s hair is a wig! A very expensive wig!"

The CEO touched his hair. It was indeed a wig. It slipped slightly.

I tried to cover it up. I grabbed Gary and shoved him into his travel cage. "Bad bird! No insider trading!"

But Gary is smart. He knew the cage was a trap. He flew out, landed on the projector remote, and hit the button. The screen behind us, which was supposed to show our quarterly growth charts, now displayed a live feed of Gary’s cage cam.

On the screen, we saw Gary whispering, "Shh, they’re watching. Tell the board the server room is on fire. It’s the only way to hide the data."
